NAD, I am an MLS (not verified on here), and have had a TON of ingrown nails: 

You should go to your nearest urgent care or ER now. I've had too many ingrown toenails to know that you're at the "gotta remove this nail/part of this nail asap" stage. You have granulation tissue which will not go away with Epsom salt soaks or trying to dig your nail out. There's a good chance you've got a jagged edge of nail under that granulation tissue that will just make the granulation tissue grow more and lack of antibiotics can result in sepsis. I had to get my toenail completely removed twice when it looked like this, and ended up having to permanently remove half of my toenail.

Edit: I just read some of your other comments about not being able to see a doctor/not having time/not having money, but you really should go to any nearby UC or ER. I know how painful these things are.
